# temps_global_secret (Resource)

A secret stored in Temps' instance secret store, for example a registry password a build reads. Changing `value` overwrites it in place.

Import with `<name>`.

Required API key permissions: `secrets:read`, `secrets:write`, `secrets:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_global_secret" "registry" {
  name        = "REGISTRY_PASSWORD"
  value       = var.registry_password
  description = "Password of the private image registry"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Secret value. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the secret is for.
- `mount_path` (String) Where a `file` secret is mounted.
- `project_id` (Number) Limit the secret to one project.
- `secret_type` (String) Type of secret, for example `env` or `file`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <name>
terraform import temps_global_secret.registry REGISTRY_PASSWORD
```
